releaseNotes: Major update combining the 1.7, 1.8, and 1.9 work. Adds Premium Session Guard game profiles, device-reported refresh-rate scanning, Private DNS checks, settings restore points, and expanded reset and logout behavior. Improves game profiles, frozen-app and overlay handling, Shizuku shell execution, system status, Premium purchase flows, and AdMob loading and cleanup. Refreshes the interface with module search and light/dark themes. Adds 13 app languages, fills missing Portuguese strings, localizes the dashboard, and fixes header layout and the Portuguese Premium label. Debug builds use Google demo ad units; release builds use ProjectZenith AdMob units and are subject to AdMob approval and serving status.
